name: model-router
description: Picks a cheaper model and effort for each subagent from how hard its task is (Haiku for a typo, Sonnet for everyday work, Opus for the hard parts), never above what it would have used, and suggests a cheaper model for simple prompts.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the suggestions the router shows.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How hard to save. careful: Sonnet at high effort for everyday tasks. balanced: Sonnet at medium effort as the base, Opus only for clearly hard tasks. aggressive: Haiku whenever it can, Sonnet for hard tasks.

rules.title: Tier rules
rules.description: Your own rules, checked first: comma separated keyword=tier pairs matched against a subagent's task, e.g. 'thesis=hard, typo=easy'. Tiers: easy, normal, hard.

askHaiku.title: Ask Haiku when unsure
askHaiku.description: When the task's words do not settle its tier, ask Haiku to judge it (a fraction of a cent per subagent). Off: an unclear task is treated as normal.

suggestMain.title: Suggest a cheaper model for simple prompts
suggestMain.description: Show a toast when a short, simple prompt goes to an expensive main model. The main conversation's model is never changed for you.
